# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTERED_GAP_FADE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An up gap that fails to hold above VWAP in low‑volatility conditions often reverts to fill the gap, offering a mean‑reversion long. This edge exists because low VIX indicates complacency, making gap continuations less likely and increasing the probability of mean reversion when the gap fails to break VWAP resistance.

## Mechanism

Entry: Enter long at the close of the second consecutive 5‑minute bar that closes below VWAP after an opening gap up (today’s open > prior close) when VIX < 15. Only trades taken within the first 60 minutes after open.  
Exit: Chart‑stop at the low of the gap bar (or prior day’s low if lower). Target at gap fill (prior day’s close) or 1.5R, whichever is reached first.
